Want a wedding that feels different from everyone else's? Try a rooftop wedding in Singapore. Picture it: your akad — the Islamic marriage ceremony — or your reception held high above the city, with glittering lights, that iconic Marina Bay view, and a sunset sky that's ridiculously romantic. Not only good-looking, but memorable for the rest of your life.

In this article we're handing you the 7 best and most Instagrammable rooftop venues in Singapore, all perfect for an akad, a reception, or even a pre-wedding dinner. Ready to get married up in the sky?

1. Ce La Vi – The Rooftop Icon Above Marina Bay Sands

Location: Marina Bay Sands, Tower 3, Level 57

Highlight: a 360° view over Marina Bay, Gardens by the Bay and the city skyline

Ce La Vi isn't only a rooftop bar — it's one of the most lavish, most iconic wedding spots in Singapore. If you want an akad or a reception that's genuinely epic, this is the answer.

Standout features:

  1. Works for an intimate or semi-private wedding
  2. A sunset view that refuses to be upstaged
  3. Ideal for an outdoor akad rolling straight into a rooftop dinner

2. 1-Altitude Coast – Chic, Relaxed and Facing the Sea

Location: The Outpost Hotel, Sentosa

Highlight: an infinity pool and a sunset view out over the South China Sea

If you want something more laid-back, 1-Altitude Coast fits perfectly. The vibe is luxury Bali resort, with a cosmopolitan Singaporean finish. Great for an intimate wedding and an outdoor akad.

Standout features:

  1. A poolside rooftop wedding
  2. Tropical decor you can customise
  3. Guests can turn it into a Sentosa staycation

3. Andaz Singapore – Modern & Seriously Good-Looking!

Location: Bugis (Levels 39 & 40)

Highlight: a 360° skyline view and artsy interior design

Andaz has a reputation as the artsy, stylish urban hotel. A rooftop wedding here suits you if you love a photo op and want a modern, minimalist feel that's still warm.

Standout features:

  1. An outdoor terrace with a city view
  2. You can combine the rooftop with the indoor ballroom
  3. The menu and decor can be curated specially

4. Mr. Stork at Andaz – A Garden on the Roof

Location: Level 39, Andaz Singapore

Highlight: garden pods and a sunset skyline view

Still Andaz, but a different spot. Mr. Stork is the outdoor garden area on the hotel roof, with a feel that's more natural and more intimate. Right for you if you want something more romantic and personal.

Standout features:

  1. A semi-private garden area
  2. Suits an intimate wedding of up to 50 guests
  3. Works for an engagement or a lamaran — the formal proposal visit — too

5. SKAI Bar at Swissôtel The Stamford – Looking Straight Out at Marina Bay

Location: Level 70, Swissôtel The Stamford

Highlight: a direct view over Marina Bay and the city skyline

SKAI is one of the highest rooftop wedding venues in Singapore. The Marina Bay view and the city lights are spectacular, especially for a late-afternoon akad running into the evening, or a dinner wedding.

Standout features:

  1. An exclusive, very private venue
  2. Great for an akad with an elegant atmosphere
  3. The wine & dine experience can be set up fine-dining style

6. Rooftop Garden at PARKROYAL COLLECTION Pickering – Eco Wedding Vibes

Location: Chinatown

Highlight: green architecture with a tropical touch, on the roof

If you want an akad or a reception that goes green and stays eco-conscious, the rooftop garden at PARKROYAL Pickering has to be on your list. It's ringed with tropical planting and green architecture that's endlessly Instagrammable.

Standout features:

  1. A semi-outdoor rooftop venue
  2. Plenty of eco-friendly floral decor options
  3. A tropical atmosphere with an urban edge

7. Level33 Marina Bay – Industrial Chic + Marina Bay Views

Location: Marina Bay Financial Centre

Highlight: views of Marina Bay Sands & the city skyline

Level33 does industrial chic on the roof — unusual and seriously stylish. Great for a young couple who want a relaxed feel that's still exclusive, for the akad and the reception alike.

Standout features:

  1. You can book the full venue for a private wedding
  2. A mix of indoor space and outdoor terrace
  3. The Marina Bay view becomes the backdrop to your aisle!

Rooftop Wedding Tips for Singapore: Beating the Wind & Keeping the Budget Safe

Before you lock in a rooftop venue, keep a few things in mind:

  1. Weather: always have an indoor or marquee backup. Singapore's weather is unpredictable.
  2. Time of the akad / reception: the best windows are golden hour (5–6pm) and after dark for the city lights.
  3. Dress code: give guests the details so they can plan an outfit for the weather & the outdoor theme.
  4. Legalities & permits: for a legally recognised akad nikah, check in with the Indonesian embassy or your religious representative first.
  5. Budgeting: a rooftop venue can cost more than a standard hotel, but nothing beats the atmosphere!

Ready to Get Married Up in the Sky?

A rooftop wedding in Singapore isn't just a trend — it's the best call if you want a wedding day that's different, good-looking and unforgettable. The city lights, Marina Bay and that night breeze make the whole thing feel magical.

On the hunt for a wedding venue that's small and warm but still looks incredible in photos? Micro weddings are having a huge moment, especially if you want something simple that still means everything. And Singapore is full of hidden-gem venues for couples who want intimate vibes, without renting out a giant ballroom.

From rooftops with a city-lights view to good-looking cafés right in the middle of town – there's something for every taste and budget. Plenty of them already bundle in a wedding package, or will build one around what you need. So here are 8 micro wedding venues in Singapore that work for 50–80 guests, all modern and thoroughly Instagrammable!

1. The Summerhouse – Garden Domes That Are Pure Dream

📍Location: Seletar, Singapore

Getting married in the middle of a garden? Absolutely doable. The Summerhouse has transparent garden domes that turn your wedding into something wildly romantic. Ideal if you love a garden-party concept with a rustic, floral finish.

Capacity: up to 60 pax

Highlight: your own private garden dome, made for an intimate reception

Vibes: romantic, nature-inspired, good-looking

2. Lewin Terrace – A Japanese Touch in the Middle of the City

📍Location: Fort Canning

This one has heritage character in spades, with a colonial building and an elegant Japanese touch. Perfect if you're drawn to a classic, vintage feel that stays intimate.

Capacity: 50–70 pax

Highlight: outdoor and indoor both available, with a calm and exclusive atmosphere

Vibes: classic-modern, heritage, intimate

3. The Alkaff Mansion – A Fairytale Wedding Fit for a Princess

📍Location: Telok Blangah Hill

If you want a wedding that feels lifted out of a storybook, The Alkaff Mansion is your answer. This heritage venue has sprawling gardens and a grand building, and it can still be set up for a small, intimate event.

Capacity: 60–80 pax

Highlight: a European heritage building, great for an outdoor party

Vibes: elegant, dreamy, European-style

4. SKAI Restaurant – Lavish & Minimalist Above the Cityscape

📍Location: Swissôtel The Stamford, Level 70

A wedding backed by the city skyline? SKAI gives you a stunning Marina Bay view from way up high. The interior is modern minimalist — spot on if you like simple but classy.

Capacity: 40–60 pax

Highlight: Marina Bay & city lights views

Vibes: lavish, modern, city wedding

5. Open Farm Community – Rustic and Eco-Friendly

📍Location: Dempsey Hill

This one is made for couples into eco-living and open air. Open Farm Community blends right into its surroundings, relaxed but still classy. Loads of young couples pick it for a fuss-free intimate wedding.

Capacity: 50–80 pax

Highlight: a sustainable concept and outdoor dining vibes

Vibes: rustic, casual, organic

6. The White Rabbit – An Old Church Turned Wedding Venue

📍Location: Dempsey Hill

This former church, now a restaurant, has genuinely beautiful architecture. With vintage interiors and a mostly-white palette, you get an atmosphere that feels sacred and still chic. Plenty of modern couples choose it for a classic-themed wedding.

Capacity: 50–70 pax

Highlight: unusual architecture, a sacred & good-looking atmosphere

Vibes: vintage-modern, sacred, clean

7. Level 33 – A Wedding with Beer & a View

📍Location: Marina Bay Financial Centre

Getting married while looking out over Marina Bay from a rooftop, with a craft beer in hand for the toast? That’s Level33! Right for a couple who want a chilled feel that still lands as wow. There are indoor and outdoor areas you can arrange as you like.

Capacity: 50–80 pax

Highlight: a brewery + rooftop combo

Vibes: industrial-chic, chill, fun

8. Cloud9 Piazza at Jewel Changi – A Wedding Above the World's Biggest Indoor Waterfall

📍Location: Jewel Changi Airport

Who'd have guessed the most iconic spot in the airport could double as a genuinely beautiful wedding location? Cloud9 Piazza has an outdoor area in the middle of Jewel, looking straight at the famous Rain Vortex. Your wedding will be unforgettable!

Capacity: 40–60 pax

Highlight: Rain Vortex views, a modern futuristic concept

Vibes: futuristic, iconic, high-end

Why a Micro Wedding in Singapore Is Worth Considering

  1. Central locations: most venues sit right in town, easy to reach on public transport.
  2. Loads of themes: from rustic garden to city glam, it's all there.
  3. Budget stays in check: a small venue = lighter costs on decor, catering and sound system too.
  4. A more personal atmosphere: fewer guests means warmer, more personal conversations.
  5. Endlessly Instagrammable: no shortage of pretty corners for pre-wedding shoots & wedding-day moments.

How to Find the Right Micro Wedding Venue

  1. Match the capacity: don't overbook — 50–80 pax is the sweet spot for intimate vibes that still feel comfortable.
  2. Pick a venue that fits the theme: garden, industrial, heritage – go with what you actually like.
  3. Ask about all-in packages: many venues already work with decor & catering vendors. Saves time & effort!
  4. Check permits & operating hours: some outdoor venues have time and sound-level limits.
  5. Book well ahead: small venues fill up fast, especially for weekends & wedding season (April–October).

The Takeaway

A micro wedding isn't only a trend — it's a new way to celebrate love with more meaning and more intimacy. In Singapore you've got plenty of venues that look great, sit centrally and stay easy on the budget. From a romantic garden dome to a rooftop over Marina Bay, you can pick by vibe and by budget.

So, ready to start planning a micro wedding that's full of warmth and genuinely lovely to look at? Pick one of the venues above and make your moment unforgettable!

Picture it: you and your partner at the altar, a light breeze coming off the sea, an orange sunset behind you, and the waves as the soundtrack to the moment you say “I do.” Bali never fails as a dream wedding destination, especially if you're after a beach wedding that's intimate, natural and — obviously — endlessly Instagrammable.

If you're hunting for a place to get married in Bali, specifically the beachfront venues everyone's talking about in 2025, relax! We've curated the 10 best wedding venues with romantic atmosphere, solid service and, of course, sea views that don't mess about. Let's get into it and find the one that fits your day.

1. Ayana Resort & Spa

📍 Jimbaran, Bali

This place is practically a legend in Bali weddings. You can marry out on the private pier at Kisik Pier with a 180-degree ocean view, or throw an exclusive after party at Rock Bar, perched on the cliff and seriously cool. Perfect if you want glamour with real privacy.

💍 Capacity: 50–200 pax

✨ Highlight: dramatic sunsets, a clifftop and a pier, luxury throughout

📸 Instagram goals: sunset at Rock Bar, pre-wedding shots on the Kisik steps

2. The Edge Uluwatu

📍 Pecatu, Uluwatu

The name does what it says — you get married literally on "the edge", right at the lip of the cliff with the open sea in front of you. The glass infinity pool is the main draw and makes your wedding photos look like they were taken mid-air! Great for a couple who want something exclusive & edgy.

💍 Capacity: 20–100 pax

✨ Highlight: a glass sky deck and that iconic Uluwatu panorama

📸 Instagram goals: a dramatic pose on the sky platform

3. Karma Kandara Beach Club

📍 Ungasan, Bali

Want a wedding party that's relaxed but still lavish? Karma Kandara gives you an exclusive venue on a private beach you can only reach by cable car. Picture getting married barefoot on white sand with the waves rolling in… pretty dreamy, right?

💍 Capacity: 30–120 pax

✨ Highlight: cable car access, a private beach, beach club vibes

📸 Instagram goals: the ceremony on the sand, the stone steps down to the venue

4. Sundara at Four Seasons Jimbaran

📍 Jimbaran Bay, Bali

Sundara has the perfect combination: a calm beachfront setting, modern interiors, and Four Seasons service that's a given at this point. Ideal for a sunset wedding that stays intimate and classy.

💍 Capacity: 50–150 pax

✨ Highlight: the Jimbaran sunset view, fine dining, a relaxed feel

📸 Instagram goals: the ceremony garden facing the sea, a lavishly styled dinner table

5. Komune Resort & Beach Club

📍 Keramas Beach, Gianyar

If boho or surf vibes are your thing, Komune is the unusual pick. It works for a laid-back beach wedding, backed by the big waves Keramas Beach is known for. Plus the beach club atmosphere makes the whole thing more fun!

💍 Capacity: 50–100 pax

✨ Highlight: the Keramas swell, beach club party style

📸 Instagram goals: a ceremony on the sand, waves as the backdrop

6. The Apurva Kempinski

📍 Nusa Dua, Bali

If you want a wedding that's lavish and grand but still right by the sea, the Kempinski Beachfront Lawn has to be on your list. A huge green lawn backed by the Indian Ocean turns the ceremony into something properly spectacular.

💍 Capacity: 80–300 pax

✨ Highlight: a big outdoor venue with an open view

📸 Instagram goals: an aerial shot of the ceremony lawn, sunset behind the altar

7. Grand Mirage Resort

📍 Tanjung Benoa, Bali

This venue gives you 2 equally good options: a glass chapel looking straight out to sea, and a beachfront area for an outdoor wedding. Right for you if you want something sacred that still sits close to nature.

💍 Capacity: 50–150 pax

✨ Highlight: a glass chapel + an outdoor beach

📸 Instagram goals: a sunset chapel shot, a walk down a sand aisle

8. Samabe Bali Suites & Villas

📍 Nusa Dua, Bali

This one is for you if you want an intimate wedding with an ultra-luxury finish. There's a clifftop venue and a private beach, both customisable to whatever concept you have in mind – from a white party to a full Balinese adat ceremony.

💍 Capacity: 20–80 pax

✨ Highlight: a cliff chapel and a private beach

📸 Instagram goals: the ceremony at a cliffside altar, dinner under fairy lights


9. Sofitel Nusa Dua

📍 Nusa Dua, Bali

Sofitel puts tropical Bali together with classic French elegance. Their Beachfront Lawn can be transformed into a genuinely beautiful outdoor wedding venue. Especially good if you love a garden party with the sound of waves in the background.

💍 Capacity: 50–200 pax

✨ Highlight: French elegance meets tropical Bali

📸 Instagram goals: a sunset ceremony, a palm tree aisle

10. Holiday Inn Resort Bali Benoa

📍 Tanjung Benoa, Bali

Looking for a great beach venue that's easy on the budget? Holiday Inn absolutely delivers. Ideal if money is tight and you still want to get married by the sea. The packages cover everything and the service is solid.

💍 Capacity: 30–100 pax

✨ Highlight: affordable packages, a handy location, family-friendly

📸 Instagram goals: a simple beach setup, a sunset kiss

Tips to Make Your Beachfront Wedding Even Better:

🌴 Go for late afternoon heading into sunset for the best atmosphere (golden hour!).

👣 Wear comfortable shoes, or go barefoot for a natural theme.

📸 Book a photographer who's done outdoor weddings before (lighting & timing is key).

💧 Have a plan B, like a clear marquee if the weather turns.

🎶 Pick an outdoor-friendly sound system so everything stays crisp next to the sea.

The Takeaway

A beachfront wedding in Bali isn't only about the location — it's about the atmosphere, how it looks, and the experience you'll carry for the rest of your life. From a lavish clifftop venue in Uluwatu to a sweet, budget-friendly wedding in Benoa, each one has its own character and a pull that's hard to argue with.

Want intimate? Lavish? Chill? It's all there!

Just pick the venue that matches your style and get ready for a warm, meaningful day on the Island of the Gods 🌺

71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000050.body_en:
Bali has been the go-to for weddings forever. But the trend keeps shifting: away from the grand wedding with hundreds of guests, and towards the intimate one that feels more personal, warmer and more meaningful. And if privacy is what you're after, nothing beats getting married at a luxury villa you can book out entirely for you and your inner circle.

So in this article we're handing you 5 of the best private villas in Bali for a genuinely exclusive intimate wedding. Each one brings something different: Uluwatu clifftop views, sunset on a private beach, or artsy bohemian styling.

Let’s dive in and find your dream villa wedding venue!

1. The Ungasan Clifftop Resort – Villa Tamarama

📍 Uluwatu, Bali

If you want your wedding to have full Hollywood wedding energy, Villa Tamarama at The Ungasan Clifftop Resort is the answer. It sits on the Uluwatu cliffs with an extraordinary view out over open sea. The architecture is modern colonial, Hamptons style – crisp white, elegant, seriously classy.

💍 Capacity: 20–50 pax

✨ Highlight: an infinity pool facing the sea, an exclusive wedding deck

📸 Instagram goals: an altar facing the ocean + an epic sunset

What makes it special:

Picture yourself walking a white aisle, fresh green gardens on either side, looking straight out at the ocean stretching away. Villa Tamarama gives you a wedding that isn't only meaningful — it's properly cinematic.

2. Tirtha Uluwatu Villa

📍 Uluwatu, Bali

Tirtha Uluwatu is famous as the wedding venue with the iconic glass chapel. But they also have a private villa that's every bit as good for an intimate wedding. Modern architecture, green gardens and an ocean view combine into a place that's calm, meaningful and lovely to look at.

💍 Capacity: 20–70 pax

✨ Highlight: a glass chapel, a private villa, big gardens

📸 Instagram goals: the chapel at sunset + dinner under the stars

What makes it special:

Tirtha Uluwatu Villa is right for you if you want a wedding with a spiritual, weighty feel to it. The place is quiet, clean and romantic without going over the top. And Uluwatu's sacred atmosphere adds something extra to the day.

3. Pandawa Cliff Estate

📍 Kutuh, Bali (near Pandawa Beach)

Want a venue that can take the whole extended family and still stay private and hassle-free? Pandawa Cliff Estate has the answer. They have several large villas in one compound you can book out entirely for the wedding. Plus it's up on the cliff with an ocean view that's a genuine wow.

💍 Capacity: 30–150 pax

✨ Highlight: room for guests & family, a clifftop ceremony, private access

📸 Instagram goals: a wedding on the giant lawn, an infinity pool party after the reception

What makes it special:

Pandawa Cliff Estate is the pick if you want a royal-family feel – exclusive, grand, but still warm. There's a big wedding lawn, beautiful villas for guests, and enough space for an outdoor dinner or a small party. Worth every penny!

4. Villa Plenilunio Uluwatu

📍 Uluwatu, Bali

Ever seen those bohemian wedding photos on Pinterest? Villa Plenilunio is the real-life version. Rustic buildings with a Balinese touch, an altar facing the sea, and artsy white timber styling. Perfect if your taste runs good-looking, chilled and not too formal.

💍 Capacity: 20–100 pax

✨ Highlight: bohemian-inspired decor, a sunset ceremony, a relaxed feel

📸 Instagram goals: a boho altar, hanging lights over the garden dinner

What makes it special:

Villa Plenilunio is like Balinese nature crossed with a Santorini mood. With white tones, rustic wood and a cracking clifftop view, your intimate wedding turns into a dream come true.

5. Villa Vedas

📍 Tabanan, Bali

If you want to get married genuinely on the beach, on exotic black sand, with real privacy and no tourists wandering through, Villa Vedas is your answer. It's a fair way from the busy parts of Bali, and that's exactly what makes it feel more intimate and peaceful.

💍 Capacity: 30–100 pax

✨ Highlight: a private beach, direct access to the sand, a luxury villa

📸 Instagram goals: a ceremony on the sand, a party by the pool

What makes it special:

Villa Vedas gives you the freedom to get married your way. Barefoot wedding? A glam concept on the sand? A BBQ dinner in the villa's back garden? All of it works. This is a genuinely flexible, fun spot for a party that feels like yours.

Why Pick a Private Villa for an Intimate Wedding?

💫 It's more personal:

You have far more freedom over the atmosphere, the guest list and the flow of the day. Not like a hotel, where it's all been templated already.

💫 Total privacy:

No strangers, no interruptions. Just you, your partner, family and the people you love.

💫 All-in packages you can customise:

From decor to food & beverage, you set it all up to your taste and your budget.

💫 The view wins every time:

These villas aren't only somewhere to stay — the sunset, the cliffs and the sea all become part of your wedding.

How to Nail an Intimate Wedding at a Private Villa in Bali

  1. Book well ahead: these exclusive villas fill up fast, especially in wedding season (May–October).
  2. Choose vendors with villa experience: every villa has its own layout & rules.
  3. Check event permits & sound restrictions: some villas cap noise levels or operating hours.
  4. Have a plan B for weather: outdoor or not, keep a clear marquee on standby in case of sudden rain.
  5. Use every corner: take the pre-wedding shots, the family photos and the off-duty moments all over the villa!

To Wrap Up

An intimate wedding doesn't have to mean an ordinary one. In fact, precisely because there are fewer guests, you can focus on quality, closeness and an experience that genuinely means something. Choosing a private villa in Bali doesn't only get you a venue, it gets you the vibes, the privacy and an extraordinary view that makes your wedding truly unforgettable.

So… ready to get married at your dream villa? ✨

No stress over awkward vendors, aesthetic decor, or a timeline in chaos. We handle all of it from A to Z, so you get to sit back and enjoy the moment with the person you love!

71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000051.body_en:
Outdoor weddings have been one of the biggest concepts going for a few years now, and Bali is the promised land. But if you're after something other than the beachfront, a garden wedding is every bit as good an option — especially if you love being surrounded by greenery, fresh air, and a calmer sort of atmosphere.

For those of you who want a wedding that's intimate, meaningful and genuinely lovely to look at, we've curated the 5 best garden wedding venues in Bali. All of them come with green landscaping and a stunning natural backdrop, and all of them make for timeless photos. Let's go through them one by one!

1. The Chedi Club Ubud (Tanah Gajah)

📍 Ubud, Bali

Ever pictured getting married in the middle of green rice fields, with mountains and trees behind you? The Chedi Club Ubud (now known as Tanah Gajah) is the definition of a luxury garden wedding with an authentic Balinese touch. The grounds are enormous and the rice-field views have no competition.

💍 Capacity: 20–150 pax

✨ Highlight: an altar in the middle of the rice fields, natural and peaceful

📸 Instagram goals: sunset over the paddies, a garden dinner under hanging lanterns

2. Kamandalu Ubud

📍 Ubud, Bali

Kamandalu is where you get an authentic Balinese wedding that still reads elegant and modern. The venue is full of tropical gardens, ponds and traditional buildings with real charm. Nature is everywhere here, which makes it perfect if you want a wedding that feels spiritual and calm.

💍 Capacity: 30–100 pax

✨ Highlight: tropical gardens and semi-outdoor spots with valley views

📸 Instagram goals: a bamboo aisle, views over the Petanu Valley

3. The Royal Pita Maha

📍 Ubud, Bali

If you want lavish, artistic and spiritual all in one place, The Royal Pita Maha belongs on your wishlist. Built by Ubud's royal family, it puts classic Balinese architecture together with a spectacular natural landscape: hills, valleys, a river, and sprawling gardens.

💍 Capacity: 50–150 pax

✨ Highlight: views over the Ayung river valley, an outdoor altar styled like a Balinese temple

📸 Instagram goals: the artful altar, traditional stone steps, the relief-carved gardens

4. The Kayon Jungle Resort

📍 Payangan, Ubud (near Tegalalang)

If jungle vibes and dramatic tropical forest views are what you want, The Kayon Jungle Resort is the perfect definition of it. There's a garden spot looking straight over a green valley, plus an infinity pool that doubles as a pre-wedding location and an after-party spot!

💍 Capacity: 20–80 pax

✨ Highlight: jungle views, an altar set among the trees, an infinity pool

📸 Instagram goals: an aisle running between tall trees, dense forest as the backdrop

5. Bali Botanical Garden Bedugul

📍 Bedugul, Bali

If you want a garden wedding that's genuinely green and cool, nothing beats the Bali Botanical Garden in Bedugul. Cool air, a thin layer of mist and towering trees give this venue a magic that no other place in Bali quite has. Ideal if you want to get married in tropical forest without the sweat 😄

💍 Capacity: 30–200 pax

✨ Highlight: natural forest gardens, cool air, great for a morning or late-afternoon wedding

📸 Instagram goals: a forest aisle, a ceremony on a wide open meadow

Why a Garden Wedding in Bali Has to Be on the Bucket List

🌿 A completely different natural feel:

The beach is great, but a garden wedding has a shaded, fresh, magical side that's every bit as beautiful.

🎨 Flexible, good-looking decor:

You can play with boho, rustic, floral or classic – all of them work in a garden setting.

💑 More intimate and calmer:

With no crashing waves or strong sea breeze, a garden is a quieter setting for the ceremony itself.

📸 Photos made for Instagram:

Natural light, trees or paddies behind you, and all that green makes every shot look good automatically!

Tips to Make Your Garden Wedding Even Better:

  1. Watch the season: ideally marry in the dry season (May–October) so rain doesn't cause drama.
  2. Comfortable shoes: skip the towering heels, they'll sink into the grass – go for wedges or great sandals!
  3. Have a plan B: hire a clear marquee just in case a local downpour turns up.
  4. Get the lighting right: hanging lamps or fairy lights make a garden dinner far more romantic.
  5. Check the sound system: sound bounces around outdoors, so make sure your sound vendor is used to outdoor weddings.

The Takeaway

A garden wedding in Bali isn't only a "venue in a garden" – it's a wedding experience that folds into nature, calmer and genuinely beautiful. From the Ubud rice fields to the Bedugul forest, Bali has plenty of garden venues and every one of them has its own thing going on.

If you want a day that's warm, intimate and full of natural colour, a garden wedding is the best call. All that's left is matching it to your theme, your guest numbers and the atmosphere you want.

So, garden or beach wedding? If you're on team #greenandnatural, the answer looks pretty clear! 🌿💍

71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000052.body_en:
A dream wedding doesn't have to be a headache. If you want something simple that still feels special, getting married and honeymooning in the same place is the most smart and practical move going. It saves time, and you can head straight into the honeymoon without switching hotels or dealing with the logistics twice.

Especially if you pick a wedding-plus-honeymoon venue in Bali. The Island of the Gods never fails to make the day more unforgettable – from the tropical atmosphere to luxury resorts with extraordinary views and five-star hotel service that has you feeling like royalty for a day.

So in this article we've curated 5 luxury resorts in Bali that work brilliantly for a wedding and a honeymoon, complete with a romantic setting, facilities that cover everything, and a feel that fits how people actually live now. Read to the end!

1. Four Seasons Resort Sayan – Get Married in the Forest, Honeymoon Somewhere Magical

📍 Ubud, Bali

Four Seasons Resort Sayan isn't only one of the best resorts in Bali, it's known as the most peaceful and spiritual place to get married. Wrapped in tropical forest and set above the calm Ayung river, it's ideal if you want an intimate Balinese wedding with real weight to it.

And the best part? You move straight into the honeymoon in a private villa with its own pool, 24-hour butler service and floating breakfast surrounded by greenery. Recharging and honeymooning at once? Absolutely doable.

💍 Wedding capacity: 20–100 pax

💑 Perfect for: couples who want calm, cool air and real meaning

✨ Romantic extras: a couples' spa by the river, dinner under the stars, yoga for two

2. Alila Villas Uluwatu – Marry on the Cliff, Honeymoon with an Ocean View

📍 Uluwatu, Bali

If clifftops and open sea are more your thing, Alila Villas Uluwatu can't be skipped. The wedding venue here looks literally out at the Indian Ocean, with the most dramatic sunset in Bali. Perfect for a wedding that's romantic and gorgeous to look at.

Once the day is done, you stay on in a villa with its own infinity pool and seriously exclusive service. Plus every villa is eco-friendly and modern minimalist — right for a stylish young couple.

💍 Wedding capacity: 20–150 pax

💑 Perfect for: couples who want an ocean view and a modern wedding

✨ Romantic extras: a cliffside spa, a private pool villa, sunset dinner by the cliff

3. The Samaya Seminyak – A Beachfront Wedding & a Honeymoon That's Chill but Luxurious

📍 Seminyak, Bali

The Samaya has exactly what you might be looking for: a central Seminyak location that somehow stays quiet, direct beach access, and private villas that are genuinely huge. You can hold the wedding right on the beach, then move into a villa with a private jacuzzi and your own butler.

Want a honeymoon that's relaxed but still luxurious? This is the place. And because you're close to Seminyak's food & nightlife, you can head out to a beach club after the party!

💍 Wedding capacity: 30–100 pax

💑 Perfect for: couples who like a laid-back feel that stays classy

✨ Romantic extras: a romantic dinner on the beach, a couples' spa, a honeymoon suite

4. W Bali – Seminyak – A Stylish Wedding, a Party-and-Chill Honeymoon

📍 Seminyak, Bali

For a couple who are fun, love a party and don't want a honeymoon that feels stiff, W Bali in Seminyak is the best fit going. The wedding venue is modern, with garden, beach or even rooftop options. And after the reception? Straight into a honeymoon with access to the bars, the beach club and the pool party. Sounds good, right?

💍 Wedding capacity: 50–200 pax

💑 Perfect for: couples who are fun, social and up for a party

✨ Romantic extras: the signature spa, an after party at Woobar, a honeymoon suite with an ocean view

5. Viceroy Bali – Honeymoon Like Aristocracy in the Middle of the Ubud Valley

📍 Ubud, Bali

If you want a wedding that's grand, private and deeply calm, Viceroy Bali is the answer. This resort is famous as one of the best honeymoon spots in Asia. With a dramatic valley view, an infinity pool and personal service, you'll feel like royalty in your own kingdom.

The wedding venue has a private garden spot and a valley edge that's stunning. Ideal for an intimate wedding with a small guest list and five-star quality throughout.

💍 Wedding capacity: 10–50 pax

💑 Perfect for: couples who want a seriously private wedding and a luxury honeymoon

✨ Romantic extras: dinner on the helipad, a villa with a private pool, a romantic buggy ride

Why Marrying and Honeymooning in One Place Is the Smart Move

1. It saves time & energy:

No faffing about moving locations or packing twice. One trip, and both the wedding and the honeymoon are done.

2. Packages can be built around your budget:

Plenty of resorts offer all-in packages: venue, catering, decor, accommodation, even the honeymoon suite.

3. Your privacy holds up better:

You get to enjoy the moment together undisturbed, because it's all handled in one place.

4. It looks good and it's Instagrammable:

Luxury resorts in Bali have no shortage of photo spots that need no fussy setup. Natural beauty + beautiful decor =

your feed looks incredible automatically!

How to Pick a Resort for the Wedding + Honeymoon:

📅 Book well ahead: 6–12 months minimum, because the top venues fill up fast, especially in wedding season.

🛏️ Ask about combined wedding & honeymoon packages: they usually work out cheaper than booking separately.

💌 Pick a venue that matches your personality: chill? party? private? Go with the resort that suits you and your partner.

📷 Use every corner: put the whole resort to work for the pre-wedding shoot, the wedding and the honeymoon.

The Takeaway

A dream wedding no longer has to be complicated or expensive. Pick a wedding venue that also works as a honeymoon and you get the meaningful, romantic part without the chaos. Bali has plenty of luxury resorts with five-star service and extraordinary views.

Want to get married in the Ubud forest, on the Uluwatu cliffs, or on a Seminyak beach? Take your pick by style, budget and preference. The main thing: enjoy the process and build memories you'll never forget.

71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000053.body_en:
A Bali wedding is the dream, obviously — beach vibes, sunset, and a tropical setting that's romantic as anything. But... the thing that trips people up is getting there. Especially for guests flying in from another city or another country who don't want to wrestle with transport the moment they land.

So if you're hunting for a wedding venue in Bali close to Ngurah Rai Airport, you've landed on the right article. We're spilling 5 great wedding venues that sit a flip-flop's throw from the terminal. Perfect if you want a destination wedding in Bali that still stays practical and comfortable for every guest — domestic and international alike.

Why Does Being Near the Airport Matter?

Before we get into the list, let's talk about why so many couples pick a Bali wedding venue near the airport:

  1. ✈️ Easy access: no scrambling to arrange transport for guests from out of town or overseas.
  2. ⏰ Saves time: especially when guests are only in for the day and can arrive and leave without any drama.
  3. 🧳 Carrying loads of stuff? No problem: being close by is far more efficient, particularly for the decor team, vendors, or family turning up with a mountain of suitcases.
  4. 🌅 You still get the beach: most Bali venues near the airport are in the Kuta area, which is right on the coast!

1. Discovery Kartika Plaza Hotel – Kuta

Location:

📍 Jl. Kartika Plaza, Kuta – only 10 minutes from Ngurah Rai Airport!

Why it works for a wedding

Discovery Kartika Plaza is well known as one of the favourite wedding venues in Kuta. It looks straight out at the sea, so you get married against an epic Bali sunset.

Venue options:

  1. A garden wedding with the beach as the backdrop
  2. An elegant ballroom for an indoor reception
  3. A private beachfront for an intimate ceremony

Facilities:

  1. 300+ rooms and suites for guests
  2. Complete wedding packages (decor through to catering)
  3. A spa & wellness centre for pre-wedding relaxation

2. Holiday Inn Resort Baruna – Kuta

Location:

📍 Jl. Wana Segara, Kuta – literally 5 minutes from the airport!

Why you'll love it

Holiday Inn Baruna is spot on if you want a relaxed feel that stays classy. A wedding here has a cool tropical mood, and guests can stay right there in a comfortable, kid-friendly resort.

Favourite spots:

  1. Envy Garden: made for a sunset wedding
  2. A poolside party for a proper afterparty

Other things going for it:

  1. Roomy, comfortable accommodation
  2. Helpful staff who are used to handling international weddings
  3. A catering menu you can adapt, with vegetarian & halal options

3. Patra Bali Resort & Villas – Tuban

Location:

📍 Jl. Ir. H. Juanda, Tuban – literally next door to the airport (about 3-5 minutes!)

What makes it different?

If you love traditional Balinese architecture but still want a luxurious, modern feel, Patra Bali is the answer. The place is Balinese to its core, with international-standard facilities.

Venue options:

  1. The Beach Lawn – works for an outdoor wedding of up to 500 pax!
  2. The Wantilan – for an intimate reception surrounded by Balinese architecture

Extra points:

  1. Plenty of villa options for family & VIP guests
  2. Big parking areas and easy access

4. Grand Inna Kuta Beach – Kuta

Location:

📍 Jl. Pantai Kuta – around 15 minutes from the airport

Why it made the list

Grand Inna sits right on Kuta Beach and has no shortage of Instagrammable corners for your wedding. The venue options are flexible too, indoor or outdoor. Plus the hotel has been around a long time and knows how to handle a big event.

Great facilities:

  1. An infinity pool looking out to sea
  2. Complete wedding packages with Indonesian catering
  3. Ballroom capacity running into the hundreds

The bonus?

It's near the shops and souvenir spots, so your guests can make an outing of it after the party.

5. The Anvaya Beach Resort – Kuta

Location:

📍 Jl. Kartika Plaza – only 5–7 minutes from Ngurah Rai Airport

What's the vibe?

Anvaya Beach Resort is seriously luxurious while still feeling warm and romantic. Perfect if you want a wedding at five-star standard. It's also a favourite with international guests because the service is so professional.

Venue options:

  1. Sands Restaurant: a beachfront view for the dinner
  2. The Wedding Pavilion for an intimate ceremony
  3. The Grand Ballroom for a big party

What makes it special:

  1. Modern contemporary Balinese design
  2. A top-tier wine & dine experience
  3. An in-house wedding coordinator

How to Choose a Wedding Venue Near Bali Airport

  1. Settle on the concept first: garden wedding? Beachfront? An elegant ballroom?
  2. Check the airport's busy hours: close is good, but make sure aircraft noise doesn't spoil things for your guests.
  3. Pick somewhere all-in-one: guest accommodation, catering, an event planner — so you're not the one running around.
  4. Look for flexibility: some venues have several spots to choose from, so you can mix and match around what you need.

The Takeaway

A Bali wedding doesn't have to mean a long trek and a lot of hassle. Pick a venue near Ngurah Rai Airport and you give every guest an experience that's practical and still unforgettable. From a garden party to a beachfront ceremony, you get all of it without the long journey.

So, ready to lock in your Bali wedding venue? Don't forget to book well ahead, because these favourites get fully booked constantly, especially in wedding and holiday season!

If you're hunting for a wedding venue that's properly dreamy, you need to go down the glass chapel rabbit hole in Bali. These aren't your average chapels. Picture walking the aisle with blue sky behind you, waves rolling in, and sunlight pouring through clear glass — pure magic.

Glass chapels are having a huge moment for modern, intimate weddings, especially if you want to marry in Bali with a look that's luxurious and simple but still unforgettable. And these chapels are designed specifically to make your day look stunning on camera. Instagram and TikTok vibes?

So here are the 5 prettiest glass chapels in Bali to add to your dream-venue list. Each has its own thing going on, and every one suits you if you want an elegant wedding with the Bali sea as the backdrop.

1. Infinity Chapel – Conrad Bali

📍 Location: Tanjung Benoa, Nusa Dua

If you've ever seen a wedding video where the chapel looks like it's floating on water, chances are it was the Infinity Chapel at Conrad Bali. The name is literal — it's built over a wide pool of water that runs straight out towards the sea, creating an infinity illusion. No wonder it's one of the most popular wedding venues in Bali.

Why you'll fall for it:

  1. A full-glass design that's seriously modern
  2. A very private, very quiet location
  3. Capacity up to 60 guests, ideal for an intimate wedding

Bonus atmosphere:

From any angle, this chapel makes your photos look cinematic. And it isn't only for the ceremony — the surrounding area works brilliantly for an afterparty or a dinner reception.

2. Tresna Chapel – Ayana Resort Bali

📍 Location: Jimbaran

Ayana needs no defending when it comes to wedding venues. But one of their standouts is Tresna Chapel — an unusually shaped glass chapel standing proud on the clifftop. The view? Straight out at the Indian Ocean.

Main advantages:

  1. An air-conditioned chapel (yes, you won't overheat!)
  2. A glass floor down the middle of the aisle for extra drama on the way in
  3. A dedicated bridal dressing room that looks incredible

Who is it for?

Couples who want to marry against the sea with a classic, elegant feel. You can also carry on to the reception at AYANA Villa, which is seriously private.

3. Wiwaha Chapel – Hilton Bali Resort

📍 Location: Nusa Dua

Wiwaha Chapel is the Hilton Bali's hidden gem. It sits high on the cliff with a sea view that doesn't mess about. The chapel itself is more traditional in design but still elegant, mostly glass and timber, which gives it a warm and genuinely sacred feel.

What's interesting about Wiwaha Chapel:

  1. Great for a late-afternoon wedding heading into sunset
  2. There's a small balcony area for a dramatic bridal entrance
  3. Hilton offers all-in-one wedding packages

Bonus:

After the akad — the Islamic marriage ceremony — or the blessing, you can head straight to dinner on Hilton's rooftop or in the garden. Zero hassle and completely practical!

4. Tirtha Uluwatu Glass Chapel

📍 Location: Uluwatu

If you and your partner want a wedding that feels sacred but still stylish, Tirtha Uluwatu is one to look at closely. The chapel stands firm on the famously beautiful, iconic Uluwatu cliffs. Its shape is a modern triangle glazed from floor to roof — natural light gets in perfectly.

What makes Tirtha Uluwatu special?

  1. Clifftop and open-ocean views, made for a sunset wedding
  2. The venue is ringed by neatly kept tropical gardens
  3. There's a private bridal suite to get ready in beforehand

5. Pearl Chapel – Samabe Bali Suites & Villas

📍 Location: Nusa Dua

Pearl Chapel is the one if you want luxury and serious privacy. It's tucked away, far from the crowds, and works for an intimate wedding of up to 80 people. The chapel's shape is thoroughly modern, mostly white with clear glass that catches the sunlight.

Key features:

  1. Direct beach access for the pre- and post-wedding photo session
  2. You can request a sunrise or sunset wedding
  3. Private villas available to stay in after the day

The feel you get:

Calm, exclusive and luxurious. Right for you if you want a 5-star resort wedding without agonising over the small details — because the Samabe wedding team handles all of it.

Things to Sort Before You Pick a Glass Chapel in Bali

So you don't end up with the wrong venue, here are a few tips worth knowing:

💡 Check the sunset time – so you can set the ceremony for the best possible light.

💡 Work out your guest numbers – chapels are usually built for intimate weddings, so know exactly how many people are coming.

💡 Book well ahead – popular venues like these get fully booked constantly, especially in holiday season.

💡 Talk through the decor – some chapels are already beautiful as they are, so you barely need to add anything. You can still personalise with your favourite colours or flowers.

💡 Ask about the backup plan – if it rains, is there an indoor option or a canopy you can use?

The Takeaway

Getting married in a Bali glass chapel isn't only about looking good. It's about creating something unforgettable and meaningful, framed by scenery you won't find anywhere else. From the grand Infinity Chapel to the ultra-exclusive Pearl Chapel, each one has its own pull.

If you're deep in wedding prep and you want a venue that's unusual, romantic and leaves your guests speechless, one of these 5 chapels could well be the answer. And don't forget, a venue like this is perfect if you want to fold the honeymoon into the trip. Practical, right?

71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000054.title_en: The 5 Most Beautiful Glass Chapels in Bali for a Wedding Straight Out of Pinterest!

A Bali wedding is already on just about every couple’s wishlist. But if you want one with a different vibe — nothing mainstream, and seriously good-looking — you need to look at the run of wedding villas with infinity pools and Venues that open straight onto the sea.

It isn’t only great for photos — it turns your wedding into an experience your guests won’t forget. From Uluwatu all the way down to Tabanan, these villas have the lot: an intimate atmosphere, open ocean, real privacy, and of course an infinity pool that delivers the “wow” the second you step onto the aisle.

So let’s take a look at 10 of the best Bali wedding villas with ocean-view infinity pools, all ready to turn your day into a once-in-a-lifetime moment!

1. Khayangan Estate – Uluwatu

📍 Location: Uluwatu, Bali

The name gives it away — "Khayangan" means heaven, and the place genuinely lives up to it. Khayangan Estate is known as one of the most exclusive wedding venues in Bali. Perched on the Uluwatu cliffs, it has an infinity pool with a view over the Indian Ocean that is pure magic.

Why it deserves a look:

  1. Elegant tropical-colonial villa design
  2. An infinity pool facing straight out to sea
  3. Event capacity up to 200 people

2. The Surga Villa Estate – Uluwatu

📍 Uluwatu, Bali

The name isn’t overselling it — this villa really is a slice of heaven if you want to get married with the ocean and a huge sweep of blue sky behind you. The infinity pool is long, made for cinematic shots with a flowy wedding dress.

Standout features:

  1. Capacity up to 120 guests
  2. 13 rooms for family and your inner circle
  3. An open-space venue with a 180° ocean view

3. Villa Plenilunio – Uluwatu

📍 Uluwatu, Bali

This one combines rustic-boho architecture with a dramatic ocean view. The infinity pool is ringed by tropical trees and natural stone — seriously pretty for an outdoor wedding that stays relaxed without giving up the luxury.

Why it works for millennial couples:

  1. There’s an outdoor chapel with the sea as the backdrop
  2. The infinity pool is made for a pre-wedding shoot

4. Villa Tamarama – Ungasan Clifftop Resort

📍 Ungasan, Bali

Villa Tamarama has a classy, faintly colonial feel. Its infinity pool looks straight out at the blue of the Indian Ocean, and the clifftop position makes the whole view more dramatic. Perfect if you want an elegant wedding with old-money vibes.

Highlights:

  1. An exclusive spot in the Ungasan area
  2. A wide lawn for the outdoor reception
  3. A private villa with a classic-modern touch

5. Soori Estate – Tabanan

📍 Tabanan, Bali

Want a wedding that doesn’t feel like Uluwatu or Seminyak? Soori Estate in Tabanan is worth a look. Its infinity pool faces a private beach of exotic black sand, with a soundtrack of waves that is genuinely calming.

What sets it apart:

  1. Modern minimalist design, made for a modern wedding concept
  2. An exclusive venue well away from the crowds
  3. The sunset is unreal!

6. Latitude Bali Villa

📍 Ungasan, Bali

Latitude has a reputation as one of the best villas in Bali for a wedding party. Picture it: a long infinity pool that seems to run straight into the sea and sky, plus photo spots that are ridiculously good.

Great for:

  1. Intimate or medium-scale weddings
  2. A proper afterparty with a DJ or a live band
  3. A staycation for the whole extended family

7. Villa Phalosa – Seminyak

📍 Seminyak, Bali

If you want wedding vibes that lean urban and sit close to the city’s nightlife, Villa Phalosa is your pick. The infinity pool looks straight out at Seminyak Beach, and you can roll into the party the moment the akad — the Islamic marriage ceremony — or the blessing is done.

Standout features:

  1. A prime spot near the beach clubs & the restaurants everyone is talking about
  2. Capacity up to 150 people


8. Villa Anugrah – Uluwatu

📍 Uluwatu, Bali

Last but not least, Villa Anugrah — iconic thanks to its perch on the Uluwatu cliffs and an infinity pool that faces straight out at open water. The design is clean and modern, ideal if minimalist-luxury is your thing.

Why it’s perfect:

  1. The natural light is superb for photos
  2. The ceremony area sits right by the cliff view
  3. Ideal for a sunset wedding

How to Choose a Bali Wedding Villa with an Infinity Pool

So you don’t pick wrong, here are a few things worth weighing up:

💡 Nail down your guest count – Some villas suit an intimate wedding (30-50 pax); others hold up to 200 people.

💡 Pick a location that matches your vibe – Uluwatu for the dramatic ocean view, Seminyak for city access, Tabanan for peace and quiet.

💡 Check the noise & curfew rules – Some villas are strict about event hours. Ask early!

💡 Ask about outside vendors – Some villas insist you use theirs. If you already have your own team, make sure the villa is flexible.

💡 Book far, far ahead! – Especially if you’re eyeing wedding season (May–October), when plenty of venues are full a year out.

The Bottom Line

If you want a wedding that feels relaxed but still glamorous, private but still memorable, a Bali villa with an infinity pool and an ocean view is the answer.

With a venue you can shape around whatever theme and mood you love, plus scenery nothing else comes close to, a Bali villa wedding isn’t just a once-in-a-lifetime event — it’s an experience you’ll never shake (and one that’ll blow up your Instagram feed! 🔥)
71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000055.summary_en: A Bali wedding is already on just about every couple’s wishlist. But if you want one with a different vibe — nothing mainstream, and seriously good-looking — you need to look at the wedding villas with infinity pools that open straight onto the sea.

71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000056.body_en:
Ever pictured getting married surrounded by timber decor, warm hanging lights, the sound of a river running past and green rice fields in every direction? Yes — that’s what people mean by a rustic wedding, a style that keeps climbing lately, especially among millennial and Gen Z couples who want something more intimate and earthy.

If you want a wedding a long way from glossy glamour but still Instagrammable and classy, a rustic Bali wedding might be exactly right. And the good news is that Bali — Ubud especially — has no shortage of gorgeous venues offering timber decor, tropical nature, and rice-field views that are unbelievably chill.

So in this article we’re spilling the 5 best rustic wedding venues in Bali, for anyone who wants to get married somewhere warm, natural and full of love.

So What Is a Rustic Wedding?

A rustic wedding is a wedding built on a strong natural feel — usually timber, earth-tone colours (brown, green, cream), soft low lighting, and natural decor like wildflowers, foliage, and rattan or hessian.

The rustic look is perfect if you want to:

  1. Get married somewhere intimate and homey
  2. Skip the fussy glam party
  3. Keep the focus on the moment and the warmth of the day
  4. Find an outdoor venue with a real view

And Bali, with all its natural beauty, is the ideal place to make that dream rustic wedding happen.

1. Kamandalu Ubud

📍 Location: Jalan Andong, Ubud

Kamandalu Ubud has every element a rustic wedding needs — strong timber architecture, wide rice-field views, and a genuinely authentic Balinese feel. The venue is like a classic mini Balinese village polished into a five-star resort.

Why does it work for a rustic wedding?

  1. An outdoor setting with rice fields and a river all around
  2. The Amrita Yoga Pavillion for the akad — the Islamic marriage ceremony — or a blessing
  3. A wedding deck that looks incredible for an evening reception

The bonus:

Kamandalu also does a romantic floating breakfast you can put to work for a prewedding shoot or your honeymoon. Honestly, the place is the full package!

2. Bambu Indah Ubud

📍 Location: Banjar Baung, Sayan, Ubud

Bambu Indah is the anti-mainstream wedding venue. As the name suggests, it’s built almost entirely from bamboo and old timber set into a natural landscape. A wedding here isn’t just intimate — it’s deeply personal and meaningful.

What makes Bambu Indah different:

  1. Every building is made from bamboo or recycled wood
  2. There’s the “Elora House” spot for a small, quietly moving ceremony
  3. A direct view over tropical forest and the Ayung river

Who is it for?

Perfect for eco-conscious couples, or anyone who wants to get married close to nature. Plus the rustic feel is already there without piling on decor.

3. Ubud Hanging Gardens

📍 Location: Desa Buahan, Payangan, Ubud

This venue is famous for a pool that lands on lists of the “world’s most beautiful infinity pools” — but don’t let that distract you, because they also have a seriously lovely rustic wedding spot! With timber architecture and dramatic green valley views, it suits a semi-outdoor wedding with a naturally elegant edge.

Wedding highlights here:

  1. A ceremony deck over the ravine (it’s safe, promise!)
  2. A semi-open venue in timber and natural stone
  3. Great for 20–60 guests — properly intimate!

The bonus:

They also have an exclusive honeymoon package you can drop straight into once the day is done.

4. Villa Beji Indah Ubud

📍 Location: Lodtunduh, Ubud

If cozy and romantic with a lot of wood in it is your thing, Villa Beji Indah is an underrated but seriously charming option. The villa hides among big old trees and a small river that keeps everything cool and quiet.

Key features:

  1. 10 traditional-style timber villas
  2. A wide lawn for an outdoor ceremony and reception
  3. Birdsong, running water and a natural breeze as your wedding “soundtrack”

For a really intimate feel:

This venue suits a wedding of <100 guests and a laid-back afterparty around a bonfire or a string of fairy lights.

5. The Kayon Jungle Resort

📍 Location: Bresela, Payangan, Ubud

If you want rustic but with a luxury finish, The Kayon Jungle Resort strikes exactly that balance. It sits in the middle of tropical forest, built from timber and natural stone with contemporary Balinese design. The rustic-and-glam mix really lands!

Dream wedding spots:

  1. Wantilan Pavilion: for the akad or a blessing
  2. A 3-tier infinity pool looking over the forest
  3. Guest capacity up to 150 people

Perfect for:

Couples who want a natural setting that still feels elegant, with a modern touch and five-star hotel service.

Tips to Get the Most Out of Your Rustic Wedding

  1. Take a late-afternoon slot: Golden hour in Bali is unbelievably pretty, especially if your venue backs onto rice fields or forest.
  2. Use natural elements: Timber, bamboo, dried leaves, local flowers and rattan all make great primary decor.
  3. Pick earth tones: Brown, cream, olive green, dusty pink and burnt orange are made for rustic vibes.
  4. Bring in live acoustic music: A live set with guitar and light vocals makes the whole atmosphere warmer and more personal.
  5. Hire natural-style documentation: Choose a photographer who is good at candids and light-tone editing so the images match the rustic mood.

The Bottom Line

A rustic wedding in Bali is about more than timber decor and hanging lights. It’s about building a wedding that’s intimate, meaningful, and feels genuinely like “you.” With a venue that sits inside nature, plus views over rice fields, a river, or tropical forest, you don’t just get somewhere to get married — you get a memory you keep for life.

Whether you want eco-friendly like Bambu Indah or glam-rustic like Kayon Jungle Resort, it’s all waiting in Bali — above all in Ubud, where the mood suits a rustic wedding best.
71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000056.summary_en: Ever pictured getting married surrounded by timber decor, warm hanging lights, the sound of a river running past and green rice fields in every direction?
71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000056.title_en: Want a Rustic Wedding in Bali? Here Are 5 Venues with Timber Warmth & Rice-Field Views That Look Incredible

71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000057.body_en:
Getting married in Bali but half your guest list is bringing small children? Don’t panic. It turns out plenty of Bali wedding venues are genuinely kids-friendly — family-ready, in other words. So you still get the wedding you dreamed about, with no worrying about anyone’s kids going cranky, bursting into tears, or getting bored halfway through.

Let’s run through 3 Bali wedding venues that work for families with children. The locations are convenient, the facilities cover everything, and they still look beautiful if a luxe Bali resort wedding is what you’re after!

Why Bother with a Kids-Friendly Wedding Venue?

Well, you might not have kids right now, but most of your guests probably do. A child-friendly wedding matters, because:

✨ Guests can actually focus on the day

✨ The children stay comfortable and safe

✨ The atmosphere is more relaxed and drama-free

✨ No worrying about a fussy toddler during the solemn part

Get this right and you’re one step ahead as a host who thinks about every guest ❤️

1. Grand Hyatt Bali

📍 Location: Nusa Dua, Bali

If you want a venue that’s elegant but family-friendly, Grand Hyatt Bali is the answer. The resort is enormous, full of tropical gardens, and — most importantly — has a kids club & family suites that cover everything.

Why does it work when guests bring children?

  1. A kids pool and a mini waterslide to keep the little ones busy
  2. Family suites available, good for guests with 2–3 children
  3. An indoor playground and kids club, safe & comfortable
  4. Babysitter service you can request straight from the hotel

Wedding vibes:

You can get married outdoors in the garden, on the beachfront, or in an elegant ballroom. Grand Hyatt Bali also has no shortage of pretty spots for pre-wedding sessions and bridal portraits.

The bonus:

You can roll straight into your honeymoon here, because the facilities really do cover everything! You could even bring the family along for a staycation and make a proper trip of it.

2. The Westin Resort Nusa Dua

📍 Location: Nusa Dua, Bali

Westin is famous for being child-friendly — and they’ve carried that straight into their wedding venue. So you get a five-star resort wedding while the children still have somewhere safe to play and explore.

Facilities for children:

  1. Westin Family Kids Club – a comfortable, cool indoor play area
  2. High chairs, a kids menu, even kids gifts for your smallest guests
  3. Staff who are genuinely trained to look after young guests
  4. Direct access to a kids-safe stretch of beach

Wedding vibes:

Beachfront wedding, tropical garden, or elegant ballroom? All of it can be arranged. You can even build a kids activity corner so the children stay busy while the adults enjoy the day.

Who is it for?

You, if you want a relaxed wedding that still feels classy. Perfect for a semi-formal concept with beachside glam.

3. InterContinental Bali Resort

📍 Location: Jimbaran, Bali

InterContinental Bali is famous for a seriously romantic sunset view. What fewer people know is that the resort is very family-friendly too. Plenty of couples pick it not only for the aesthetics but for how complete the facilities for children are.

Why is it a family favourite?

  1. A large outdoor kids playground
  2. Baby-sitting service on request
  3. A kids menu for the wedding catering
  4. Roomy, comfortable suites for families

Wedding vibes:

An intimate beach wedding or a full-scale wedding in the tropical gardens? Both work. You can also add a wedding picnic session or fun games the children can join in with.

Added value:

Being in Jimbaran makes the trip from the airport easy — ideal for domestic and international guests travelling with kids.

How to Make Your Wedding More Kids-Friendly

🍼 Set up a kids corner or mini playground

Give the children a small area for colouring, puzzles, or story books. You can rent a mini tent or a playmat to make it even cuter.

🎁 Hand out kids goodie bags

Fill them with healthy snacks, bubbles, stickers, or small toys. Simple, but it keeps children happy and occupied.

🍽️ Put a kids menu on the table

Make sure there’s food that actually works for children — nuggets, pasta, or mini nasi goreng. And don’t forget juice or milk boxes!

🪑 Provide high chairs

Five-star venues usually have them, but confirm the number matches how many children are coming.

👩‍🍼 Consider an extra babysitter

You can work with a local vendor or ask the hotel to lay on a professional nanny for the whole event.

🎉 Run games or bubble time outside the main programme

It’s fun, it keeps the children excited, and it keeps them clear of the main moments like the akad — the Islamic marriage ceremony — or the speeches.

The Bottom Line

A Bali wedding is the dream for a lot of people. But if you want a day that’s friendlier to families, especially guests bringing children, you need a kids-friendly venue.

With venues like Grand Hyatt Bali, Westin Resort Nusa Dua and InterContinental Jimbaran, you get to marry with a clear head, your guests get to enjoy the day, and the children stay happy — nobody stuck carrying a toddler through an entire reception.

Because a good wedding isn’t only about “how it looks”, it’s about “how it feels” — for everyone who turns up.

71000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000058.body_en:
Picture it: you’re walking down the aisle in the gold of a setting sun, waves rolling in behind you, every guest staring at the view over your shoulder. Sounds like a dream? It isn’t. A sunset wedding in Bali can absolutely make it real.

A sunset wedding isn’t just hype. For couples who love a romantic mood and genuinely beautiful natural light, saying your vows as the sun goes down is a moment nothing replaces. Especially in Bali — an island of iconic beaches and cliffside views with no real rival.

So let’s spill 3 of the best sunset wedding venues in Bali, all proven favourites with local and international couples.

Why Is a Sunset Wedding in Bali So Popular?

A sunset wedding isn’t only about the aesthetics. It’s about a mood and an ambience you simply can’t fake. Natural light at golden hour makes everything feel magical — the photos included!

  1. Natural light makes your photos & video flawless on autopilot
  2. Cooler temperatures, more comfortable guests
  3. The Bali sky at sunset = the backdrop you dreamed of
  4. You can roll into an evening afterparty with no break
  5. You save on the lighting budget, because golden hour already looks good

On top of that, a sunset setting suits a romantic, minimalist, rustic — or even beach party — wedding concept.

1. Rock Bar Ayana – Getting Married on a Cliff, Lit by an Unfiltered Sunset

📍 Location: Jimbaran, Bali

No argument here — Rock Bar Ayana is one of the most iconic sunset venues in Bali (and in the world!). Sitting on a rock outcrop at the water’s edge, it’s literally elevated and facing due west. Meaning? A 100% clear sunset, nothing in the way!

Why is Rock Bar such a favourite sunset wedding venue?

  1. The most dramatic sunset view in Bali
  2. The wedding area can be set up on the Rock Bar private deck
  3. Natural light plus the reflection off the sea makes the whole thing epic
  4. It connects straight to Ayana Resort (honeymoon sorted!)

Perfect for:

Couples who want a luxurious wedding that still feels natural. If you love ocean vibes and an editorial-magazine backdrop — this is the place.

2. Karma Kandara – A Wedding on a Private Beach + the Sun Setting on the Horizon

📍 Location: Ungasan, Bali

If you want something more chilled but still exclusive, Karma Kandara is the hidden gem to consider. The venue sits on a private beach you can only reach by funicular — a mini cable car down the cliff. Pretty fun, right?

What Karma Kandara does well:

  1. The sun sets right on the ocean horizon — no distractions
  2. A private beach makes the whole day more intimate
  3. The venue can be set up outdoors on the sand or up on the cliff
  4. Seriously kids-friendly & family-ready

Perfect for:

Couples who want a casual wedding that still feels classy. A sunset wedding on this beach suits a boho, rustic, or tropical barefoot concept.

3. Finns Beach Club – Sunset Wedding and All-Night Party in One

📍 Location: Canggu, Bali

If you’re the fun type, you love a party, and you want the wedding to roll straight into the afterparty without moving anywhere, Finns Beach Club is it. Sunset here is always the highlight, because the place faces dead west along a long, unobstructed stretch of beach.

What makes Finns different?

  1. Sunset views from the deck by the pool & the beach
  2. The sound system & lighting are already in party mode
  3. Plenty of spots to choose from: wedding deck, VIP area, or the beachfront
  4. You can rent space for a DJ, a band and a bar at the same time

Perfect for:

Young couples who want a wedding that’s sacred but also memorable because it’s fun, stylish, and a little wild (in a good way!).

How to Land the Best Sunset Wedding Slot in Bali

💡 Book far ahead: Sunset slots fill fastest, especially in the dry season (May–October). Ideally you’re booking 8–12 months out.

💡 Watch the golden hour timing: Sunset in Bali usually lands between 17.45 and 18.30 depending on the season. Get your planner (yes, 7Magic!) to schedule the akad — the Islamic marriage ceremony — or the main session right inside that window.

💡 Check where the sun actually goes: Not every seaside venue is automatically good for sunset. You need to know which way the sun sets, which way the wind blows, and what the cloud does.

💡 Use a professional documentation team: Sunset happens once. Your photographer and videographer have to understand golden hour angles and lighting, or the whole thing is wasted.

💡 Don’t overdo the decor: Sunset is already beautiful. Let the view be the star, not decorations that end up hiding it.

The Bottom Line

A sunset wedding in Bali isn’t a trend — it’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience. With the right venue, the right timing and an experienced wedding organizer behind you, you get a moment every guest remembers, and so do the two of you.

From Rock Bar Ayana with its luxury and drama, to Karma Kandara with its relaxed romance, to Finns Beach Club with all that energy, any of them can be the perfect place to say your vows as the Bali sky turns burnt gold.

So, still stuck on a venue? Or worried another couple will grab the sunset slot first? Relax… 7Magic Organizer is ready to help from day one until you’re officially married, with the best sunset view going. 🌅💍

Once you start planning a wedding you’ll hear these two words constantly: mahar and mas kawin — the bridal gift the groom hands over at the marriage ceremony. People use them interchangeably, which leaves plenty of couples wondering, “Hang on, are these two different things, or just two names for the same thing?”

Relax! This article will help you understand the difference — or maybe the sameness — between mahar and mas kawin. Keep scrolling for the answer before you say “it’s official!”

So What Are Mahar and Mas Kawin?

Where the Words Come From

  1. Mahar comes from Arabic — al-mahr — meaning the gift the groom hands to the bride during the akad nikah, the Islamic marriage contract.
  2. Mas kawin is the term used more often in Indonesian. But in meaning, honestly… it’s the same thing! So there’s no big difference, just a different label.

Both carry the same symbolic weight: a sign that a man is serious about, and ready to take responsibility for, building a household with his partner.

What Mahar / Mas Kawin Is Actually For

Beyond being a symbol of love and commitment, the mahar is also a sign that the groom-to-be is financially ready. Think of it as an opening guarantee that he’s prepared in every sense (wallet included 😅).

It’s also a mark of respect for the bride and her family. So it isn’t about the number, it’s more about good intentions and sincerity.

Form and Value: It Doesn’t Have to Be Expensive, It Has to Mean Something

Mahar and mas kawin don’t always have to be money. They can also be:

  1. Gold
  2. A set of prayer equipment
  3. Memorised passages of the Al-Qur’an
  4. Something symbolic (a favourite book, a plant, even a fancy coffee 😍)
  5. Or even a service! (teaching video editing, say — seriously, this happens!)

As for the value, it comes back to what the two sides agree on. There’s no benchmark saying it has to be a certain number of millions, or take a certain form.

Who Decides the Amount?

People ask all the time, “What’s the minimum for a mas kawin?” or “If I can’t manage gold, is that okay?”

The answer: absolutely fine! Even in Islamic teaching there’s no fixed benchmark for the amount. What matters is that it is:

  1. Agreed by both sides
  2. Stated clearly during the akad
  3. Given willingly, never under pressure

That said, adat — local customary tradition — in parts of Indonesia does come with “unwritten rules” about the number. So it’s worth talking it through with the family, so everyone feels settled and comfortable.

When Does It Get Handed Over?

Usually the mahar or mas kawin is given at the akad nikah. But some couples:

  1. Hand it over before the akad (basically a mahar deposit 😅)
  2. Pay it in instalments if they can’t cover the lot at once
  3. Pay part up front and the rest later, by agreement

The important thing is that it’s all written down and agreed together, so it doesn’t turn into a problem later.

Mahar = 100% the Wife’s

This part really matters! Once the mahar or mas kawin is handed over, it belongs entirely to the wife. The husband can’t take it back, and definitely can’t ask for it to be returned 🤨

If you’re torn about choosing a mahar that’s meaningful and holds its value long term, gold is a safe bet. It’s timeless, its value is stable, and it works as savings for the future.

The Bottom Line: Mahar and Mas Kawin = Two Names, One Meaning

If you’re still on the fence, just remember:

Mahar and mas kawin are the same thing. The difference is the word, not the meaning.

What matters most about the mahar/mas kawin is:

  1. That it’s agreed together
  2. That it’s given willingly
  3. That it stands as a symbol of good intentions and honest love

So don’t stress over the number. Focus on the meaning, and on the intentions you bring to building a life together ❤️

As the wedding gets closer, looking fit, healthy and confident becomes the main goal for a lot of couples. It isn’t only about the makeup or a show-stopping dress — it’s about being in the kind of shape that lets you look your absolute best on the day.

So if you’re hunting for a way to stay in shape before the wedding, this article is for you. Here are 7 workouts that are dead simple but genuinely effective at getting you looking all out on the aisle.

1. Push-Ups: Small Movement, Big Payoff

Push-ups look basic, but don’t be fooled — this move is seriously powerful for:

  1. Tightening up arms and shoulders
  2. Straightening out your posture
  3. Burning calories fast

If you’re just starting out, try knee push-ups first. Once you’ve got them, move up to diamond push-ups to build the chest more. Perfect if you want lean arms and a wedding dress that sits exactly right 😍

2. Plank: The Anti-Lazy Move for Better Posture

The plank is basically an all-in-one workout. You barely move, but the effect is enormous on your:

  1. Abs
  2. Back
  3. Shoulders and legs

Try holding a plank for 30 seconds every day, then upgrade to a side plank to shape a slimmer, tighter waist. This is the secret to looking lean without an extreme diet!

3. Burpees: Fast Fat Burn Before the Wedding

Want a workout that’s quick but maxed out? Burpees are the answer. This squat + push-up + jump combo helps you:

  1. Burn more calories
  2. Build stamina
  3. Shape full-body muscle

If you’re not used to exercising yet, skip the jump at first. Once you are, burpees will get you toned and ready to wear a kebaya or a suit with real confidence!

4. Pilates: For a More Elegant Silhouette

Pilates is ideal for a bride or groom-to-be who wants:

  1. A leaner shape
  2. Better posture
  3. A tighter core and hips

Plus it helps you relax as the day approaches. You barely need equipment — a yoga mat and some floor space in your bedroom is enough to get going!

5. Yoga: Calmer, Fitter, More Focused

A lot on your mind before the wedding? Give yoga a go.

Moves like:

  1. Downward dog
  2. Warrior pose
  3. Tree pose

can help you:

  1. Get positive energy flowing
  2. Improve your flexibility
  3. Take the edge off stress and sleep better

Yoga also makes you more mindful, so on the day itself you can actually enjoy the moment, happier and full of love 💕

6. Jogging: Simple, and It Never Fails

If working out at home isn’t your thing, just step outside and jog around the neighbourhood — that alone is plenty! What jogging does for you:

  1. Builds stamina
  2. Shapes leg muscles
  3. Releases endorphins, so your mood keeps improving

For the best results, try 20–30 minutes of jogging, 3-4 times a week. Do it with your favourite playlist or a wedding podcast to keep the motivation up 😍

7. Swimming: Full-Body Workout and Relaxation at Once

Want a workout that’s fun, sweat-free, and still delivers? Swimming is the solution. In the pool you can:

  1. Work almost every muscle in your body
  2. Tighten arms, shoulders, core and legs
  3. Burn calories while you relax

Perfect if you want the shape you’re after but still want to enjoy it and not go too hard. Bonus: your skin will look fresher too, from all that time in the water 💦

Extra Tips to Keep Your Workouts Consistent:

  1. Make a regular schedule and stick it on the fridge
  2. Find a workout partner in your partner-to-be
  3. Set mini goals every week (hold a plank for 1 minute, jog 5 km)
  4. Reward yourself when you hit some progress (a small cheat meal is allowed 😋)
